miniatures.config.base_run_delay.desc: The minimum delay in ticks before a miniature will begin running towards a block that it can break.
miniatures.config.breaks_blocks.desc: If true, miniatures will attempt to break blocks that are tagged as such. [default: true]
miniatures.config.destroys_blocks.desc: Whether or not miniatures will destroy (break without dropping) blocks in the default block break tag.
miniatures.config.distraction_chance.des: Chance per tick that a miniature will be distracted from breaking a block. [default 0.05]
miniatures.config.hostile.desc: If true, miniatures are automatically hostile to players. [default: false]
miniatures.config.non_player_immune.desc: If true, miniatures are immune to any damage whose source is not directly (or indirectly) a player [default: true]
miniatures.config.owner_rider.desc: If true, miniatures will only attempt to pick up their equivalent player owner.
miniatures.config.pickup_goal.desc: Whether or not miniatures will attempt to pick up players.
miniatures.config.random_run_delay.desc: The maximum value that can be added to the run delay.
miniatures.config.skip_null_check.desc: If true, the null profile cache isn't consulted, which means skin loading may be delayed.
miniatures.config.title: Miniatures
